RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, April 2, 2018/Chaitra 11, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Defence; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Earth Sciences;
Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Information and
Broadcasting; Mines; Panchayati Raj; Road Transport and
Highways; Rural Development; Science and Technology;
Shipping; Textiles; Water Resources, River
Development and Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 15
Shortage of soldiers in
armed forces
*361. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
shortage of officers and soldiers in the
armed forces;
(b) if so, the details thereof, service-
wise;
(c) whether Government has
conducted any study on it during the last
three years;
(d) if so, the details thereof,
State-wise; and
(e) the details of steps taken by
Government to tackle the problem of
shortage of soldiers in armed forces?
Delay in payment of salary to
officials of Prasar Bharati
*362. DR. SANJAY SINH: Will the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to the
delay by Government, some employees
of Prasar Bharati did not get their
salaries for the month of February, 2018
on time;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
due to an internal clash between the
Ministry and Prasar Bharati the same
problem had occurred in October, 2017 as
well; and
(c) if so, the reasons behind such
repeated delays and action taken by
Government thereon?

127
Contracts for live coverage of events
by private firms
*363. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Mumbai based firm had
been awarded contracts for live coverage
of opening and closing ceremonies of
International Film Festival of India, Goa,
2017 instead of Doordarshan which covers
bigger events like Republic Day and
International Yoga Day;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons and justifications
therefor;
(d) whether Government would initiate
an inquiry into the award of the contract to
private firms instead of Doordarshan; and
(e) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor?
Rehabilitation of trainee officers
disabled during training
*364. SHRI PARTAP SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the trainee officers
disabled during training at various military
academies in the country during the last
three years and the current year;
(b) whether Government proposes to
formulate any scheme to absorb such
trainee officers including those disabled
during training at Indian Air Force
Academy, Hyderabad, in suitable alternate
employment;
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
the proposed scheme will be implemented
and if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of other steps taken/being
taken by Government to rehabilitate the
disabled trainees?
Additional funds for MGNREGS
*365. SHRI A.K. SELV ARAJ: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether about 88 per cent of the
funds available for the Mahatma Gandhi
National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme (MGNREGS) have already been
exhausted halfway through the financial
year;
(b) whether Government had claimed
that this year's MGNREGS budget is the
highest ever;
(c) whether it is also a fact that there is
a need of an additional amount of
` 17,600 crore to meet the requirements
under MGNREGS; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of minimum wages
under MGNREGA
*366. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in many
States, Mahatma Gandhi National Rural
Employment Guarantee Act
(MGNREGA) wages are lower than those
fixed for unskilled agricultural labour under
the Minimum Wages Act of States, if so,
the details of the difference in the amounts,
State-wise;

128
(b) the detailed reasons for not
accepting the recommendations of the
Mahindra Dev Committee, which
suggested a convergence of the wages paid
under State Minimum Wages Act for
unskilled agricultural labour and the
MGNREGA wages; and
(c) the estimated cost if MGNREGA
wages are paid at a rate equal to the States
Minimum Wages Acts ?
Course for Sanitation Supervisors
*367. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR: Will
the Minister of DRINKING WATER
AND SANITA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is planning to
start a course for Sanitation Supervisors
in the near future;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any fixed timeline
to start this course; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of IAY/PMAY

the Minister of RURAL

(a) the allocation criteria for Indira
Awas Yojana (IAY)/Pradhan Mantri Awas
Yojana (PMAY);
(b) whether allocation is based on the
Below Poverty Line (BPL) census;

Single technology platform for
procurement of arms and
equipment
3841. SHRI HUSAIN DALWAI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is planning to
build a single technology platform for
procurement of arms and equipment, if so,
details thereof and if not, reasons therefor;
(b) the timeline for setting up this IT
division;
(c) whether this initiative will help in
making the country self-reliant in its
defence needs; and
(d) the steps Government will take to
ensure transparency and confidentiality in
terms of data revealed on the IT system?
Grievances of Grand Power s.r.o.,
Banska Bystrica
3842. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister's office
had received any grievance letters from the
Grand Power s.r.o., Banska Bystrica, in
2017;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the said company had
communicated the PMO as regards to
Indian Defence Attached being tasked to
do company verification on 2nd August,
2017;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the Defence Attache had
submitted his report on the verification of
the said company; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?

903
Memoranda received from NECC
3843. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of memoranda the
Ministry has received through Speed Post
from National Ex-servicemen Co-
ordination Committee (Regd.) (NECC),
duly forwarded by various Union Ministers
and Hon'ble Members of Parliament (MPs)
during last four months, including the latest
forwarded on 30 November, 2017; and
(b) the issues raised therein and action
taken by Government thereto?
Restoration of ex-servicemen category
to MNS officers
3844. SHRI ANUBHA V MOHANTY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Officers
of the Military Nursing Service (MNS),
who were eligible, were accorded the ex-
serviceman category on retirement from
service with all the facilities attached with
it;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the grant
of ex-serviceman category to the MNS
officers on retirement has been withdrawn;
(c) if so, since when and the reasons
therefor including details of the said order;
and
(d) whether the Ministry is considering
the restoration of ex-serviceman category
to the officers of the MNS with immediate
effect?
Development of indigenous fighter
aircraft
3845. SHRI PARTAP SINGH BAJWA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the projects to
indigenuously develop fighter aircraft are
behind schedule;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the steps taken by Government to complete
these projects expeditiously and to provide
adequate number of aircraft for operational
preparedness of the Indian Air Force (IAF);
(c) whether most of the aircrafts in the
possession of IAF, require immediate
upgradation or replacement; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken in this regard?
Cadre review and recruitment in B&S
cadre of MES
3846. SHRI K.R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Director
General (Personnel) has been defying the
order of President, regarding
implementation of first cadre review of
Barrack and Store (B&S) Cadre of Military
Engineer Services (MES) for past three
months;
(b) if so, the details of administrative
action taken thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether it is also a fact that direct
recruitment of officers of B&S cadre has
not been done during last eight years;
(e) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the details of action plan to fill the
existing vacancies?
Filling up of posts in B&S cadres of
MES
3847. SHRI K.R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 1573 posts

904
of Barrack and Store (B&S) Cadre of
Military Engineer Services (MES) were
revived through Ministry of Finance during
September, 2016;
(b) if so,  the details of vacancies filled-
up till date;
(c) if not, reasons for delay of 18 months
in filling up of vacancies;
(d) the date by which all revived posts
will be filled-up alongwith details of
recruitment/DPCs conducted during last
three years at each level; and
(e) the details of DPC conducted during
last three years in respect of all cadres of
MES at each level with present position of
each case?
